summary.text: Braxton Mitchell is a Republican member of the Montana House of Representatives from District 5, where Ballotpedia lists his tenure as beginning in 2021, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat Luca Welle.
He chairs the House Agriculture Committee and works as a small businessman and consultant.

paragraphs.text: Mitchell was born in Whitefish, Montana, and earned a high school diploma from Columbia Falls High School.
His career experience includes working as a small businessman, a consultant, and with Vandevanter Meats.
Ballotpedia lists him as a Turning Point USA ambassador, a RunGenZ rising star, vice-chair of Montana Young Republicans and an NRA Lifetime Member.
In the 2025-2026 session Mitchell was assigned to the Energy, Technology, and Federal Relations, Rules, Judiciary and Agriculture committees, chairing the Agriculture Committee.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 2, 2026.
